links.label: Bureau of Land Management, Alaska Fire Report 1970 (Internet Archive)

location_hint.precision: AMBIGUOUS: the report says only 'Bald Mountain' in the Anchorage-Palmer area. GNIS has Bald Mountain Ridge (Mat-Su, Anchorage C-7 NE, closest to Palmer) and a Bald Mountain summit (id 1893466) in Mat-Su in the Talkeetna Mountains (62.3080,-149.7540), much further from Palmer; the ridge is the likelier but this is a name match, not a source statement.
location_hint.from: https://www.usgs.gov/us-board-on-geographic-names/domestic-names (Domestic Names bulk file, cached at data/raw/gnis)

extra.access_text: Mount Gordon Lyon carries the former Nike Site Summit missile complex above Arctic Valley, on the edge of Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson (per a JBER web page seen in a search snippet; the page returns 403 to our fetcher). Whether the lookout was on or beside it is not stated.
